'''January 2001 Mountain View tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Neutral Ground, Mountain View, California on 26 January 2001. [[Alfred Dong]] won it. It is known from Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1695">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-02-mt-view-1-26d1695/ mt-view-1-26], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 2 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-02-mt-view-1-26d1695/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 26 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Neutral Ground, Mountain View, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Alfred Dong]]
